idea_name: New campaign around an old service model
description: Refreshes language and campaign assets while preserving the same service model and assumptions.
Redesigns the strategic concept around hidden burden and stakeholder agency.
Transfers prevention and early-warning logic from public health into strategic service design.
Uses adaptive personalization to tailor user pathways but has unresolved trust and systems concerns.
Changes the governance system so implementation evidence updates decisions and roles.
Stages a low-risk prototype before major commitment.
Replaces short-term output metrics with learning and system health indicators.
Creates an ongoing co-design studio for affected stakeholders and implementation owners.
Produces an impressive event but little mechanism for strategy or learning.
Develops several strategic options tested across plausible futures.
